title: Wringer graph event
description: One line of graph.jsonl. Append-only, one JSON object per line, in the order things happened, each carrying the hash of the line before it. This schema describes a single line, not the file.

ts.description: Local ISO-8601 with UTC offset, millisecond precision.

prev_hash.description: sha256 of the previous line, or 64 zeros for the first.

to.description: The node or sink a route selected.

when.description: The route expression that matched, verbatim.

ref.description: A path to another bundle — loop or delivery. Referenced, never nested: one run, one bundle, one place.
